units.source_text: 那天清晨，车站上只有相川和友子两人。

en.t: That early morning, only Aikawa and Tomoko were at the station.
Perhaps it was just as well that I did not come.

units.source_text: 友子不是拿着橙子来送行……

en.t: Tomoko had not come to see him off carrying oranges...

units.source_text: 她在公共马车里，一边挥动阳伞，一边像是想起昨日的舞曲而欢闹似的。

en.t: She was in the public carriage, waving her parasol and making merry as though she had remembered yesterday's dance music.
